thread:
Anya K: Heads up — deploybot just aborted the quantized-kernel canary in eu-west1, checksum mismatch on the shard package.

deploybot: ACTION: canary aborted for rollout: runtime-quant-v2. Reason: artifact checksum mismatch (sha256).

Lee S: ugh. Was this the new matmul quant bundle?

Anya K: yeah, matmul-qbundle-2026-03-20.tgz. local verify shows different sha than the one in the release manifest.

Mike L: I pulled the artifact and re-hashed. My machine: `sha256sum matmul-qbundle-2026-03-20.tgz = 3f7a9b...c4`. Release manifest expects `9b2c1d...a7`.

Olivia R: Is the mismatch only for eu-west1 or all regions? deploybot said eu-west1 only because that canary ran there first.

Anya K: quick check — pushed to staging clusters in us-west2 and eu-west1. us-west2 has the expected hash; eu-west1 got a different object from the blobstore replica.

Mike L: likely eventual consistency/replica lag in the blobstore after the republish. There was a background rehydrate yesterday.

lee S: if it's a blobstore inconsistency we should NOT roll forward. Plan: pin runtime to previous quant-kernel (runtime-quant-v1.9) for all traffic, abort current rollout, and re-upload artifact with a new immutable name.

Anya K: Agreed. Suggest steps: 1) deploybot pin runtime-quant-v1.9 across all regions immediately. 2) mark canary aborted and block auto-retry. 3) Mike re-publish with deterministic name `matmul-qbundle-2026-03-20-rev1.tgz` and attach new sha. 4) run staged revalidation: us-west2 -> eu-west1 -> ap-southeast1.

deploybot: NOTE: pin applied to runtime route `matmul-serve` -> pinned to runtime-quant-v1.9. Auto-retry disabled for rollout id 77321.

Olivia R: I'll open a quick incident ticket so we have an audit trail and keep product/ops in the loop. We should also update release notes to call out republish and that model weights were unchanged (just packaging).

Mike L: I'll re-publish now with `-rev1` suffix and force replicate. Posting new hash in ~5m.

sre-bot: @channel Incident created: INC-2026-1288. Severity: P2. Link: https://incidents/redwood/INC-2026-1288

Anya K: For rollback/rollback-criteria: if any region shows a different artifact after replication or if smoke fails (latency regress > 10% or error rate > 0.5%) we keep pin and open rollback to last stable image. Otherwise we'll schedule a controlled re-deploy during the maintenance window (tomorrow 02:00-05:00 UTC).

Lee S: QA: please run the quantized performance and correctness smoke on rev1 artifact against the baseline prompts we use for release gating. I'll share the prompt set in #eng-runtime-qa. If all good, we'll canary 5% traffic in us-west2, hold 30m, then expand.

Olivia R: Release notes update: add a short entry "Packaging re-publish: checksum mismatch detected in eu-west1 replica; artifact re-published as matmul-qbundle-2026-03-20-rev1.tgz. No model changes. Canary aborted and runtime pinned to runtime-quant-v1.9. Follow-up validation planned."

Mike L: New hash: `sha256: 3f7a9b6c2e...d114`. I've triggered cross-region replicate with higher priority and a verification webhook to confirm digest matches manifest.

Anya K: Thanks. I'll wait for the verification webhook and QA signoff before we touch traffic. If the webhook fails or reports mismatch, we escalate and keep the pin until SRE/infra resolves underlying blobstore inconsistency.

deploybot: VERIFICATION: new artifact `matmul-qbundle-2026-03-20-rev1.tgz` replicated to eu-west1; digest matches manifest.

Lee S: QA smoke pass in us-west2 ✅. Latency and correctness within thresholds.

Olivia R: I'll schedule the controlled re-deploy in the 02:00 UTC window and send calendar invites to ENG-ONCALL and QA. Also adding a short note in the ops-runbook about pin timeline.

Anya K: final ask: Mike, can you add an immutable artifact policy to the packaging pipeline so future republish increments name automatically? (e.g., include commit sha or timestamp)

Mike L: yup — filing infra task INFRA-2394 to make names deterministic + webhook verification step. ETA: 48h for the quick fix, longer for audits.

Anya K: Great. Thanks everyone. Leaving pin in place until tomorrow change window. :thumbsup:

Lee S: copying this to release-notes draft and will attach the incident link.

sre-bot: Incident INC-2026-1288 updated: state=investigating, owner=Olivia R.
